I’m thrilled to announce Baba , The American Healthcare Company. Baba connects older adults and their families with dedicated advocates who can coordinate their care. Our advocates are nurses and social workers who have worked at the front lines of the healthcare system for decades, and who can get folks the resources they need. We're also announcing more than $6.5M in funding, led by General Catalyst alongside Genius Ventures , Soma Capital , and Ground Up Ventures , some of the best angels in the world like Jordi Hays and Kareem Amin , and many more. By 2030, for the first time in history, there will be more Americans over 65 than under 18. Healthcare administration costs have already ballooned to become the single biggest expense in almost every state, and people still fall through the cracks. But this is a story of redemption. America has the most hardworking doctors, innovative universities, and generous benefits in the world. Our challenge is not one of a failed healthcare system, but one suffering from broken care coordination. Baba’s network of advocates acts as the connective tissue to make people healthier, save money, and reduce fraud. We’re hiring across engineering, design, and operations. This is not your normal healthcare team. Baba is more than 50% former founders, with a team from Stripe, Liquid AI, Palantir, MIT, CMU, and Waterloo. We count IOAI gold medalists and Palantir Meritocracy Fellows among our ranks. There’s something sacred in pushing yourself to your limits in the company of other ambitious, committed people. Our days are chaotic and uncertain, but never dull, and we each believe we’re doing our lives’ best work. Apply below: https://lnkd.in/dfKCqF4n ...more ...more
